$ C:\ProgramData\anaconda3\python.exe stage2b_camera_tof.py --help
exit_code=0
usage: stage2b_camera_tof.py [-h]
                             {register,status,inspect,coverage,solve,validate,stability-diagnostics,advanced-diagnostics,suggest-next,export-candidate} ...

Dynamic Stage2B Camera<->ToF calibration candidate tool (no promotion)

positional arguments:
  {register,status,inspect,coverage,solve,validate,stability-diagnostics,advanced-diagnostics,suggest-next,export-candidate}
    register            register one formal complete 11-frame scan by safe
                        unique pose ID
    status              show dynamic registry and available QA
    inspect             inspect registered data, or one formal scan read-only
    coverage            derive distance/angle/zone/timing coverage from
                        observations
    solve               rank all D4 x range semantics x nominal/low-
                        dimensional models
    validate            scan-level heldout, dynamic LOPO and residual
                        diagnostics
    stability-diagnostics
                        dynamic fraction-based subset stability
    advanced-diagnostics
                        read-only D4 gauge, range semantics, provenance and
                        Camera mapping diagnostics
    suggest-next        diagnostic-driven, snake-route-compatible capture
                        advice only
    export-candidate    export candidate and DELTAR fr artifacts; never
                        promote

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
